Sydney Airport Investigates Fourth Safety Incident in Weeks

Australian authorities are investigating a fourth safety incident at Sydney Airport within the last month. The incidents involve close calls, raising concerns about aviation safety. Details of the specific nature of each incident have not been fully disclosed, but the frequency has prompted a thorough review.
